Introduction

LUNA was a five-member fictional project boy band created for SBS' drama "Let Me Be Your Knight".

In the drama, the group has been active since 2016, making their debut with the single "Eternal", and consists of Yoon Taein (portrayed by former U-KISS member Jun Young), Seo Wooyeon (portrayed by actor Jang Dongjoo), Kim Yuchan (portrayed by former Wanna One member Yoon Jisung), Lee Shin (portrayed by former NU'EST member Kim Jeonghyeon), and Woo Gaon (portrayed by AB6IX's Kim Donghyun), who was added to the group in 2019.

For the drama, the group released five singles: "Love Paranoia", "Beautiful Breakup", "Let Me Be Your Knight", "Love One Day" (Yoon Taein/Jun Young solo), and "Rock & Roll Tonight". They eventually disbanded with the end of the drama.
